stalls.where: 延平街233號（文化路夜市內）
stalls.summaryZh: 約60年老店，以豆漿取代糖水，豆花細綿、豆味濃，常要排隊；網友推薦配油條一起吃。
stalls.summaryEn: A roughly 60-year-old stall that serves tofu pudding in soy milk instead of syrup; silky and strongly soy-flavored, usually with a line. Fans suggest adding youtiao.

stalls.summaryZh: 招牌葡萄柚綠茶果肉多，常大排長龍；網友多建議微糖，酸甜較平衡，適合配鹹食解膩。
stalls.summaryEn: Known for grapefruit green tea packed with pulp and frequent long lines; reviewers suggest less sugar for a better balance, and it cuts through greasy snacks.

stalls.where: 中正路361號（文化路夜市旁）
stalls.summaryZh: 三代老店，沙茶湯頭長時間熬煮、味道濃郁，人潮多常需排隊；屬夜市周邊店面，營業時間較早收。
stalls.summaryEn: A three-generation shop famous for its rich, long-simmered shacha broth; expect a queue. It is a shopfront next to the market and closes earlier than the stalls.

stalls.en: Guo Family Chicken Rice & Kueh Soup
stalls.summaryZh: 超過90年歷史的老字號，雞肉飯與粿仔湯是經典組合，營業到很晚，網友常當宵夜。
stalls.summaryEn: A 90-plus-year-old institution; the chicken rice plus kueh soup combo is the classic order, and late hours make it a popular midnight snack.

sources.title: 食尚玩家｜嘉義夜市攻略
Trip.com｜嘉義美食推薦

stalls.summaryZh: 魚肉鮮甜、羹湯好喝，但只在土魠產季營業且價格偏高，去之前要先確認。
stalls.summaryEn: Fresh, sweet mackerel in a well-liked thick soup, but it only opens during mackerel season and is pricier than average, so check before going.

sources.title: GoFunIt｜嘉義美食懶人包
食尚玩家｜嘉義夜市攻略

stalls.where: 中央噴水池圓環旁（文化路口）
stalls.summaryZh: 嘉義火雞肉飯代表店之一，位在噴水圓環旁，是逛文化路順路必吃的觀光名店。
stalls.summaryEn: One of Chiayi's best-known turkey rice shops, right by the central fountain roundabout, an easy add-on to a Wenhua Road visit.

sources.title: Trip.com｜嘉義美食推薦

stalls.summaryZh: 深夜才開的炒飯攤，米粒分明、鑊氣足又不油，可加辣，是夜貓族宵夜選擇。
stalls.summaryEn: A late-opening wok stall: fluffy, separate grains with good wok aroma and little grease; chili on request. A favorite for night owls.

sources.title: GoFunIt｜嘉義美食懶人包

stalls.summaryZh: 懷舊古早味米糕淋甜辣醬，看似清淡但鹹度剛好，常搭魚羹一起點。
stalls.summaryEn: Old-school savory sticky rice with sweet chili sauce; looks plain but is well seasoned. Often ordered with fish soup.

sources.title: GoFunIt｜嘉義美食懶人包

stalls.where: 延平街270-1號，蘭桂坊花園酒店旁
stalls.summaryZh: 現炒鱔魚麵是夜市必點之一，每天進貨有限，用餐尖峰人多，早點去較保險。
stalls.summaryEn: Wok-fried eel noodles are a market must; daily stock is limited and peak hours get busy, so arrive early.

stalls.en: Huang Mao Ya Tou Dongshan Duck Head
stalls.summaryZh: 1997年開業，滷過再炸的鴨頭帶淡淡中藥香、甜而不膩，假日常要排隊。
stalls.summaryEn: Since 1997; the braised-then-fried duck has a gentle herbal note and isn't cloying. Expect a queue on holidays.

stalls.summaryZh: 只在晚上營業的火雞肉飯，雞肉片給得厚實、調味到位，是熱門宵夜點。
stalls.summaryEn: Evening-only turkey rice with generous slices and solid seasoning; a popular late stop.

stalls.where: 噴水圓環旁、中山路309號土地銀行前
stalls.summaryZh: 約六十年的老攤，魷魚刷上甜鹹醬汁炭烤，口感軟Q，現烤現吃最香。
stalls.summaryEn: A roughly 60-year-old stall; glazed dried squid grilled over charcoal, chewy and best eaten right off the fire.

sources.title: 食尚玩家：文化路夜市周邊９必吃（2023）

stalls.summaryZh: 營業三十多年，螺肉加大量九層塔、蒜和辣椒快炒，有嚼勁不硬。
stalls.summaryEn: 30+ years in business; snails flash-fried with lots of basil, garlic and chili, chewy without being tough.

sources.title: 食尚玩家：文化路夜市周邊９必吃（2023）

stalls.summaryZh: 福州系傳統餅，鹹的包蘿蔔絲、冬粉和蛋，甜的是花生芝麻；只賣到傍晚。
stalls.summaryEn: A Fuzhou-style pastry: savory with radish, vermicelli and egg, or sweet with peanut-sesame. Open only until early evening.

stalls.summaryZh: 多篇推薦名單上的魯味攤，有網友甚至認為是文化路最值得回訪的一攤。
stalls.summaryEn: A braised-snack stall on several must-eat lists; one reviewer called it the one stall worth coming back for.

stalls.summaryEn: About fifty fried items to choose from; clean stall, not greasy, and open until late.
